projects.title: Standard Draft
projects.description: A two-sided legal tech platform where both parties negotiate from one shared, neutral contract form instead of trading marked-up Word documents, cutting a routine enterprise contract from 31 days to about six hours.

features.name: One shared neutral form
features.description: Both sides work the same live document from a neutral starting form, ending the opening fight over whose template wins and removing the document ping-pong that made contracts take a month.

features.name: Templating engine
features.description: Every contract type lives as a template the platform assembles at runtime. An NDA runs to eight sections with three levels of nesting; configure a point on the left and the agreement rewrites itself on the right, at any depth.

features.name: Five-view comparison engine
features.description: Renders each contract five ways: clean, marked up, your changes, the counterparty's changes, and the diff against the neutral form, plus a full version history chain, so nobody re-reads the whole document to find what moved.

projects.title: Education.org
projects.description: An AI research platform for Education.org, a non-profit whose evidence guides where NGO funding and effort go, that turns 1,000+ unsearchable, multilingual documents into cited answers returned in seconds.

features.name: Ask Evidence tool
features.description: A plain-language question goes in and a written, cited answer comes back, drawn from Education.org's own research. It runs the same way for the internal team and for the public, with a Sources card naming the exact document and inline markers tying each claim back to a real study.

features.name: Evidence Library & ingestion pipeline
features.description: Every document is processed on the way in: language is detected, scanned files are read with OCR where needed, and non-English material is translated through DeepL into one common knowledge base, so a single question can reach across the entire collection.

features.name: Search automation
features.description: Scrapers pull documents automatically from sources like the World Bank and the African Education Database, gathering more than a thousand documents across five source types into one place, turning days of manual desk searching into an unattended process.

projects.title: CTDAI
projects.description: In five weeks, Ionio built CTDAI, an autonomous SEO platform for dental practices that runs eight specialized AI agents to read a clinic’s online footprint, benchmark nearby competitors, and publish ranking content—turning Connect the Doc’s hand-delivered service into a recurring SaaS product.

features.name: Scout System
features.description: Eight specialized agents (Local, Review, Website, Content, Ranking, Competitor, Strategy, Listing) each scan one slice of a clinic’s online presence in parallel, doing in seconds what a human SEO team would take days to assemble by hand.

features.name: Clinic Score
features.description: Everything the Scouts find rolls up into a single score out of 100 with a plain-English read, turning scattered data on rankings, reviews, and competitor gaps into one clear verdict a busy practice owner can act on.

features.name: Growth Plan
features.description: Beyond diagnosis, the platform identifies losing searches, generates publish-ready SEO content accurate to the practice, fixes technical issues, and tracks competitors continuously so the plan stays current.

projects.title: GLEAC
projects.description: Ionio turned GLEAC’s 1,000-person mentor network into an AI-native platform, cutting mentor onboarding from an hour to under ten minutes and doubling intake (100% increase). Six AI systems shipped over two years, from a voice interviewer to automated evaluation and matching.

features.name: Voice Interviewer
features.description: A live, conversational onboarding that reads an applicant’s LinkedIn profile and generates every question in real time from their prior answer, so no two interviews are alike and answers are hard to fake with ChatGPT.

features.name: Mentor Evaluation System
features.description: Automates the three-human evaluation batch that once took three to four weeks, aiming to cut manual effort roughly 95%, bring approvals down to same-day, and remove the inconsistency of evaluators scoring the same application differently.

features.name: Micro Practice Engine
features.description: A RAG-based recommendation system with three entry points—a pasted LinkedIn profile, a plain-language question, or an uploaded document—that resolves to a journey map of relevant lessons and a conversational walkthrough of situational questions.

projects.title: Dispute Dine
projects.description: Ionio built DisputeDine, a SaaS platform that automatically disputes fraudulent refund claims across DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub. Built in 8 weeks, it recovers ~$2,500 per location monthly while eliminating 10-12 hours of weekly manual work.

features.name: Undetectable Browser Automation
features.description: Puppeteer-driven automation (with Selenium fallback) files disputes on platforms that have no dispute APIs. Randomized delays, natural mouse movements, and session persistence make it indistinguishable from a human so accounts don’t get flagged.

features.name: 2FA Interception System
features.description: Intercepts platform 2FA verification codes via a controlled email inbox, parses them, and injects them into the waiting automation session within the 60-second expiry window, enabling logins without human intervention.

features.name: Dispute Intelligence Engine
features.description: Analyzes each claim’s reason, order value, and items to generate customized, evidence-based rebuttals with platform-specific formatting, then tracks dispute outcomes and credited amounts back into the dashboard.

projects.title: SupplierHQ
projects.description: A SaaS database of high-ticket suppliers and distributors built for an e-commerce coaching program, turning 3-7 minutes of manual research per supplier into a bulk export in minutes. It reached 1,000+ paying users and recovered 3x development costs within the first month.

features.name: Supplier Discovery Engine
features.description: A searchable database of thousands of verified suppliers with contact details, product types, price points, margins, and MAP policy status, backed by Redis caching for sub-2-second responses. It replaces hours of Googling with a single interface.

features.name: Smart Filtering
features.description: Lets users drill down across 700+ product types by distributor, category, country, and date added, with competitive-metric toggles and search-demand sliders. It collapses weeks of niche research into seconds.

features.name: Distributor Database
features.description: A one-click toggle between Suppliers and Distributors, showing which middlemen aggregate which brands. It surfaces the right distribution partners without duplicated research effort.
